title: Revelation Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Revelation 10: the mighty angel with the little open book, the seven thunders and the book that tasted sweet.

questions.text: What was on the head of the mighty angel coming down out of the sky?
questions.explanation: The mighty angel was clothed with a cloud, a rainbow was on his head, his face was like the sun and his feet like pillars of fire.

answers.text: A rainbow
A golden crown
Seven stars
A crown of twelve stars

questions.text: Where did the angel set his feet?
questions.explanation: He had a little open book in his hand, and he set his right foot on the sea and his left on the land.

answers.text: Both feet on the sand of the sea
On the altar that is before the throne
On Mount Zion with the Lamb
His right foot on the sea, his left on the land

questions.text: What happened when the angel cried out with a loud voice?
questions.explanation: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars, and when he cried the seven thunders uttered their voices.

answers.text: The seven angels sounded their trumpets
The seven thunders uttered their voices
There was silence in heaven
The sky was removed like a scroll

questions.text: What did the voice from the sky say about the words of the seven thunders?
questions.explanation: The narrator was about to write, but a voice from the sky told him to seal up the things which the seven thunders said and not to write them.

answers.text: To write them in a little book
To proclaim them to the nations
To seal them up and not write them
To give them to the seventh angel

questions.text: What did the angel swear as he lifted his right hand to the sky?
questions.explanation: He swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven, the earth and the sea and all that is in them, that there will no longer be delay.

answers.text: That the earth will be measured
That the nations will be gathered for war
That the holy city will be trodden under foot
That there will no longer be delay

questions.text: When is the mystery of God finished, according to the angel?
questions.explanation: The angel said that in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

answers.text: In the days of the voice of the seventh angel
When the seventh seal is opened
When the two witnesses are killed
When the seven bowls are poured out

questions.text: What did the voice from heaven tell the narrator to do?
questions.explanation: The voice said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

answers.text: Measure the temple of God and the altar
Write down what the thunders said
Take the open book from the hand of the angel
Come up into heaven at once

questions.text: What did the angel tell the narrator to do with the little book?
questions.explanation: The angel said, “Take it, and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

answers.text: Seal it with seven seals
Take it and eat it
Give it back to the seventh angel
Hide it in the wilderness

questions.text: What happened after the narrator had eaten the little book?
questions.explanation: It was as sweet as honey in his mouth, and when he had eaten it his stomach was made bitter.

answers.text: He fell down as though dead
He was carried away in the Spirit
He could no longer speak
His stomach was made bitter

questions.text: What was the narrator told at the end of the chapter?
questions.explanation: They told him, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

answers.text: That he must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages and kings
That he must measure the holy city and its temple
That he must seal the servants of God on their foreheads
That he must write to the seven assemblies in Asia
